# Security policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please report security problems privately, not as a public issue:
open the **Security** tab of this repository and choose **Report a
vulnerability**. Only the maintainers see the report.

Include the somora version (`somora --version`), what you did, and what
happened. Leave out keys, tokens and other secrets.

You get an answer within a few days. Once a fix is released, the
report can be published with credit to you if you like.

## Supported versions

Fixes go into the current release. Update with `somora update`.

## How somora is secured

[docs/security.md](../docs/security.md) describes who can reach the
server, the login key, what an agent may do, and what somora sends to
the internet.
